To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the optimal policy is to modify the μc rule by a randomization factor which can be computed by a simple algorithm.

the optimal dynamic policy for multiplexing heterogeneous packet types with hard constraint is a randomized modification of “μc rule”; the randomization factor is the solution of an optimization problem that can be solved in real time by an algorithm that we give.

the optimal dynamic policy for the multiplexing problem with a hard constraint on a single traffic type is a randomized version of the well known “μc rule” and that the optimization problem is equivalent to finding the optimal randomizing factor.
In summary, our research is concerned with
optimal dynamic multiplexing of traffic with hard constraint, and with the development of a new algorithm for solving this problem.
the problem of optimal dynamic multiplexing of a heterogeneous traffic mix onto a single channel.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have shown that it is possible to optimize a linear combination of average delays of heterogeneous packet types while simultaneously constraining the average delay of one of the types.

the optimal dynamic policy for multiplexing heterogeneous traffic with hard constraints can be implemented in a real time environment, and that it is not significantly different from the optimal policy without hard constraints.
the optimal multiplexing policies for heterogeneous traffic with hard constraints are very similar to those for the homogeneous case.

, in the case of a single constraint on one of the traffic types, it is possible to find an optimal policy which can be implemented on-line, in real time.
